name: Session Hooks
description: Claude Code hooks that enforce board rules deterministically instead of via prompt text. mcp-core/cw-hook.mjs is a CLI (bundled to dist/mcp-server/cw-hook.mjs) taking --event PreToolUse|Stop|SessionStart plus --repo-key/--worktree/--task-id/--phase on argv (hooks do not inherit the MCP server env). It reads the hook payload from stdin and prints the contract JSON. PreToolUse denies Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit when no task is in-progress (bound task if CODE_WORKBENCH task id given, else any in-progress task unassigned or in the session's worktree; .code-workbench and scratchpad paths allowed). Stop blocks a phase-bound session whose task is still in-progress without a handoff or a "blocked" memo, once (stop_hook_active). SessionStart injects the bound-task reminder. McpConfigBuilder.writeHookSettings (mcp.ts) writes session-<id>.settings.json with the hooks block; SessionManager.buildLaunch passes --settings. Toggle: codeWorkbench.hooks.enabled. All hook failures fail open.
guidelines: Keep decide* functions pure (payload, tasks, ctx) so they stay unit-testable; I/O lives in main().
Pass hook context via argv, never env.
Every error path in a hook must allow — a broken hook must not wedge a session.
anti_patterns: Do not add prompt rules a hook can enforce.
Do not make the Stop hook block more than once per stop (honor stop_hook_active).
